Supply and demand of power

SHRI RAJIV RANJAN
SINGH 'LALAN':
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased

Reduction in the strength of CISF
*351. SHRI B. J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) what is the total number of
employees in the Central Industrial
Security Force, category-wise i.e.,
executives, ministerial etc.;
(b) whether there is any reduction

sector units;

deployed its staff; and

Measures taken to defend borders

Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) the measures taken by Government

Myanmar, Bangladesh and Bhutan; and
(b) the steps taken by Government to

countries and to control the terrorists

Recommendations of Law
Commission on detection and
deportation of illegal migrants

CHANDRAIAH: Will the Minister of

(a) whether the Law Commission has
made any recommendations for early
detection and deportation of illegal

agencies;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that the Centre has
considered the recommendations of the Law

(d) whether Government have now

help provided to them?
Restructuring the power sector
*355. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the power
sector is facing do or die situation;
(b) if so, what steps the Ministry are
taking or propose to take to restructure the
power sector to make it commercially
viable;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the SEBs
losses amount to 1.8 per cent of the GDP of
the country; and
(d) if so, how the Ministry propose to
recover the dues from the SEBs?
Subsidised power supply to
agriculture
*356. SHRI P ARMESHWAR
KUMAR AGARWALLA: Will the
Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether subsidised power supply to
agriculture is only benefiting the large and
affluent farmers who own electric pumps;
(b) whether Government have made any
survey or assessment in this regard;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether State Governments are being
advised in this regard; and
 (e) if so, the details thereof and steps
proposed so that benefit reaches small and
poor farmers equally?
Settlement of displaced Hindus of
Kashmir
†*357. SHRI RAJNATH SINGH
'SURYA': Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the places where the displaced Hindus
of Kashmir have been settled alongwith the
number of such persons;
(b) the details of the schemes for their
rehabilitation;
(c) whether they can exercise their right
to vote in the ensuing elections; and
(d) if not, what steps are being taken in
this regard?
Power supply to Kerala
*358. SHRI N.K. PREMA-
CHANDRAN: Will the Minister of
POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether NTPC has taken a decision
to reduce and regulate the power supply
due to Kerala;
(b) the arrears outstanding to NTPC from
KSEB as on March, 2002;
(c) whether Government propose to
initiate any steps to avert the regulation of
power so as to avoid drastic power cut in
the State; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Protection for the places of worship
*359. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether in view of recent Fidayeen
attack at Raghunath Temple in Jammu,
Government have formulated any new
strategy to protect the places of worship
of Hindus in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

108
F:\WIN2\SESSION 99RS.PM5
(c) whether Union Government have
called for detailed report from the State
Government of Jammu and Kashmir about
the steps taken to protect Hindu places of
worship; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Scheme for uplifting the standard of
rural people
†*360. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
introduced any Gramodaya Scheme for
uplifting standard of living of people in rural
areas of the country and providing
necessities like potable water, housing,
nutrition, primary health and rural
electrification;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the main objective of the said
scheme;
(d) the details of targets fixed by
Government under the said scheme; and
(e) the steps being taken by
Government to achieve the said targets and
bring prosperity in the villages?

Land taken from tribes by BALCO
†2523. SHRI DILIP SINGH JUDEV:
Will the Minister of COAL AND MINES
be pleased to state:
(a) the land taken from the Scheduled
Tribes in Korba (Madhya Pradesh) by the
Bharat Aluminium Company;
(b) whether the State Government has
taken any action to return this land to its
owners; and
(c) if so, the owners to whom the land
has been given back?
Repair of Ganga dragline machine in
Jayant Project of Northern Coalfields
Ltd.
†2524. SHRI MUNAVVAR HASAN:
Will the Minister of COAL AND MINES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Rs. 50 crores
were spent on repairs of Ganga dragline
machine under Jayant Project of the
Northern Coalfields Limited in the year
2000-2001;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that repair
work was got carried out by local people
and not from the original company resulting
in payment of fake bills;
(d) whether Government propose to
conduct an enquiry into the whole matter
after transferring officers connected with
the operation of 'Ganga dragline machine';
(e) if so, by when; and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?
Leasing rights to French company for
exploration of bauxite ores
2525. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY: Will the Minister of COAL
AND MINES be pleased to state:
(a) whether the global corporate
Pechiney of France has sought leasing rights
from the Government of India for
exploration of bauxite ores; and
(b) if so, how soon their application will
be processed and leasing rights issued?
Promoting foremen to the posts of
engineer in various projects of NCL
†2526. SHRI MUNAVVAR HASAN:
Will the Minister of COAL AND MINES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the foremen
engaged in the various projects of the
Northern Coalfields Limited, Singrauli have
been working on the same post for the last
twenty years;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

posts of engineers (E-2) have been filled in

(d) if so, what are the difficulties in
promoting the foremen who have been
working for the last twenty years on the
same post to the post of engineers; and
(e) by when, Government propose to
promote the above foremen to the post of
engineer?
Production of zinc
2527. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of COAL AND
MINES be pleased to state:
(a) what is the average annual production
of zinc in the country and what has been the
annual production during the last three years,
year-wise;
(b) what was the share of Andhra
Pradesh in this production; and
(c) what efforts are being made by HZL
and Government to increase zinc production
in the country?
Investment in Kala-Kote Coal Mines in
J&K
2528. MIRZA ABDUL RASHID: Will
the Minister of COAL AND MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) how much amount has been invested
in Kala-Kote Coal Mines at Kalakat, in
Jammu and Kashmir;
(b) what is the ratio of Central and State
Government in respect of investment on this
project;
(c) how many employees have been
working in this coal mine permanently or
casually and since when; and
(d) what is the annual income and
expenditure on this coal mine and what is
the status of this project in respect of loss
and gain?
Cases of survey licences and mining
leases from Madhya Pradesh and
Chhattisgarh
†2529. SHRI DILIP SINGH JUDEV:
Will the Minister of COAL AND MINES
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of cases received every
year for search permits, survey licences and
mining leases in M.P. and Chhattisgarh
during the last three years;
(b) the details thereof in each case; and
(c) the details of the decision taken
regarding each of these cases?
Licences and permits to MNCs for
prospecting of minerals in AP
2530. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of COAL AND
MINES be pleased to state:
(a) whether prospecting licences or
reconnaissance permits have been granted
by Government in favour of multinational
companies for aerial prospecting of minerals
in Andhra Pradesh;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the multinationals will also
tap the minerals in the State; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Committee for the development and
value addition of marble and granite
†2531. SHRI DILIP SINGH JUDEV:
Will the Minister of COAL AND MINES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether any committee was
constituted in October, 1998 for the

and granite;
(b) if so, the details of the objectives and
members of these committees;

commitees; and
(d) the details regarding the
implementation of these recommendations?
Plan to disinvest Neyveli Lignite
Corporation Limited
2532. SHRIMATI  S. G.  INDIRA: Will
the Minister of COAL AND MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to disinvest Neyveli Lignite Limited, a public
sector limited;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government is aware of
strong resentment over the reported move;
and
(d) if so, the reaction of the Government
thereto?
Risk of Indo-Pak war
2533. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR
REDDY: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-item "Risk of
Indo-Pak war highest since' 71: CIA’’:
appearing in the Hindustan Times dated 8th
February, 2002;
(b) if so, whether Government shares
this perception of threat of a war;
(c) the steps taken/proposed to be taken
to keep the country in state of defence
preparedness; and
(d) whether Government will like to
defuse the situation and if so, the details of
the steps to be taken in this regard?
International Defence Exhibition in
New Delhi
†2534. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether any international defence
exhibition was recently organised for the
South Asian countries in New Delhi;
(b) if so, the names of the countries who
participated in it and what are the equipments
put on display by these countries in the said
expo; and
(c) the details of the talks if any, held by
our Government in connections with
procurement of any equipments from any
such country?
Skilled/unskilled employees in
Jabalpur based factories
†2535. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of employees working in
Jabalpur based ordnance factories and the
percentage of skilled and unskilled
employees in them;
(b) whether the ratio of skilled and
unskilled employees is ideal for better
production and if not, the measures being
taken in this regard; and
(c) what are the reasons for not utilising
the technical trained youth there?
Modernisation of Ordnance Depots
†2536. SHRI D.P. YADAV: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any scheme under
Government's consideration for

554

modernisation of major Ordnance Depots
of armed forces in the country;
(b) the total number of incidents of fire
taken place in Ordnance Depots during the
year 2001-2002 alongwith the total loss of
lives and property therein; and
(c) whether Department has formulated
any comprehensive scheme to check
recurrence of incidents of fire in future; if
so, the details thereof?
Manufacturing Sukhoi 30 MK-I
aircraft by HAL with Russian
collaboration
2537. SHRI AIMADUDDIN AHMED
KHAN (DURRU): Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Hindustan
Aeronautics Limited has finalised plans
and blue prints for manufacture of
140 Sukhoi 30 MK-I fighter aircraft, with
Russian collaboration;
(b) if so, the terms of the collaboration;
and
(c) the steps so far taken in pursuance
thereof?
Special cooling suit designed by
Defence Scientists
2538. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that defence
scientists have designed a special cooling
suit for soldiers deployed in areas that are in
high temperature zones;
(b) if so, whether these suits have been
supplied in all high temperature zones;
(c) whether the scientists who designed
these suits have suitably been rewarded by
Government; and
(d) if so, the details in this regard?
Indo-US joint action against terrorism
2539. SHRI RUMANDLA
RAMACHANDRAIAH: Will the Minister
of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether India and the US have agreed
to counter mass destruction terror jointly;
(b) if so, whether the US team will work
with its Indian counterpart in a Table-top
military exercise to counter terrorists who
have weapons of mass destruction;
(c) whether there could be a joint military
training and exercise to deal with terrorism
in the context of Kashmir; and
(d) if so, to what extent this will help to
check the terrorist activities in Jammu and
Kashmir?
Exacting norms for defence purchase
2540. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR
REDDY: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that new norms
for defence purchase are considered too rigid
by the representatives of defence industry
as mentioned in the news-item "Defence
purchase norms exacting" appeared in the
Hindu of 17th March, 2002; if so, their
objections; and
(b) what steps, if any, are proposed to be
taken to relax the norms?
Accidents of MIG aircrafts
2541. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is true that between 1997
and 2000, out of 84 accidents 69 per cent

555
WIN2\SESSION\100RS 555
involved the MIG series and of which 38
were MIG-21s alone;
(b) whether it is also true that Indian Air
Force would need MIG-21 for another
15 years as it has overwhelming numbers
of its squadrons; and
(c) if so, what precautionary steps are
being taken by Government to avoid the
accidents of MIG-21s?
Modernisation of Naval Shipyards
2542. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that modernisation
of Naval Shipyards is essential for
indigenisation of Navy and enable the
country to occupy a prominent place in the
world;
(b) if so, the details of the programme
carried out by the Ministry for modernising
the Naval Shipyards; and
(c) the details of reasons for slow pace
of modernising?
Casualties of Jawans due to explosions
in Jaisalmer, Rajasthan
†2543. SHRI BACHANI LEKHRAJ:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a number of
Jawans have died and sustained injuries as
a result of explosions during the last six
months in Jaisalmer, Rajasthan;
(b) if so, the number of Jawans who
suffered casualties and injured;
(c) whether Government have conducted
any enquiry into the above explosions; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Submarine building programme for
Indian Navy
2544. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have approved
a 30 year submarine building programme to
meet the needs of Indian Navy;
(b) if so, whether these submarines
will be built indigenously or with the
collaboration of some other country; and
(c) the details in this regard?
Extension of road from Khori-wali to
Nandansar in J&K
2545. MIRZA ABDUL RASHID: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a 10 km. road
from Darhal bus-stand to Khori-wali,
important to block militants, has been
constructed by the Army in Rajouri District
of Jammu and Kashmir;
(b) if so, whether Government propose
to extend this road by 15 km. from Khori-
wali to Nandansar thus making the area safe
from militants and providing access to many
meadows and lakes for the benefit of the
people and tourists; and
(c) if so, the steps being proposed by
Government in this regard?
Complaints regarding separation of
widows of soldiers from their in-laws
after taking deceased benefits
†2546. SHRI DEVI PRASAD
SINGH: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
any complaints where widows of the
soldiers killed in 'Operation Vijay' in Kargil
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Army operations, settle, down with some
other persons by separating themselves
from their in-laws families after taking the
benefits available to them;
(b) the State-wise number of such
complaints received by Government wherein
it has been stated that parents of martyrs
have lost their financial support after losing
their sons; and
(c) the concrete action taken by
Government on such complaints?
Casualties of army personnel in
accidents
2547. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 50 army
personnel were killed in accidents between
December 19, 2001 to March 15, 2002;
(b) if so, the reasons for such heavy
casualties; and
(c) the measures being taken by
Government to avoid such accidents?
Use of private trucks by MoD for
transportation of its goods
2548. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Ministry
of Defence is using private trucks for
transporting goods/arms/ammunition of the
Ministry from one place to another; and
(b) if so, the number of trucks the
Ministry, on an average is using per year
for transporting its goods?
Ordnance depots surrounded by
commercial and residential
buildings
†2549. DR. A.K. PATEL: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) the number of ordnance depots which
are surrounded by commercial and
residential buildings in the country;
(b) whether Government are considering
to remove such depots to protect the lives
and properties of the residents adjoining
them;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Pakistan nationals remained in India
due to discontinuation of
Samjhauta Express
†2550. SHRIMATI SAVITA
SHARDA: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that due to the
discontinuation of Samjhauta Express a
number of Pakistani nationals have
remained in India;
(b) if so, whether Government are
considering to take steps with regard to
deport them to their country; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Irregularities in the money spent by
MCD for maintenance of roads in
Delhi
2551. SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
SHRI BHAGATRAM
MAHNAR:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have seen
newspaper report titled "Congress seeks

557

CBI probe on MCD graft" appearing in the
Asian Age, New Delhi on 20th November,
2001;
(b) if so, the details of money collected
from different agencies by the MCD for
maintenance of roads in the city;
(c) the details of the money spent by the
MCD and whether there are irregularities
noticed in actual utilisation of the amount;
and
(d) if so, whether the matter has been
referred to the CBI and if not, the reasons
therefor?
Hijacker of IC-814 arrested in
Pakistan
2552. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that one of the
